sloka: निवर्तमानः त्वरितो जगाम आश्रमम् आत्मवान् ।आत्मनः च अपनयनम् मृग रूपेण रक्षसा ॥३-५७-११॥
transliteration: nivartamānaḥ tvarito jagāma āśramam ātmavān ।ātmanaḥ ca apanayanam mṛga rūpeṇa rakṣasā ॥3-57-11॥

translations.english: On hearing the jackal's howl, Rama began thinking how the demon in the form of a deer drew him away. Thus in the midst of apprehensions he reached Janasthana.
